# bob gmail

Save Gmail threads as inert mail notes, linked from tasks

```text title="bob gmail --help"
Gmail threads you choose become inert, append-only mail notes: a read-only login by default through gog, then save threads offline and link them from tasks. Every send goes through a previewed Gmail draft. The `new` and `reply` commands create local notes without sending. Bare `bob gmail` lists saved threads.

Usage: bob gmail [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  attach     Import one listed Gmail attachment into the vault
  doctor     Check the Gmail setup: gog, client, account, token, scopes, config, writer, and journal
  draft      Create or update a Gmail draft and show its exact preview
  link       Swap Gmail URLs for labelled links to saved mail notes
  list       List saved Gmail threads (offline unless --remote)
  login      Connect Gmail in one guided step
  logout     Remove Bob's Gmail grant only; prints the Google revoke URL
  new        Create a local Gmail compose note
  peek       Preview Gmail thread metadata without saving it
  reply      Add a Reply section to a saved Gmail note
  save       Save or refresh Gmail threads as inert mail notes
  search     Search Gmail threads for a picker
  send       Preview and explicitly send a Gmail draft
  sync       File labelled Gmail threads into area or project notes
  unarchive  Move Bob-owned archived Gmail messages back to the Inbox
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -a, --all
          Show every saved thread instead of the newest 20

  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: table or json

          [default: table]
          [possible values: table, json]

  -r, --remote
          Fetch live new-message counts from Gmail

  -h, --help
          Show help

Running `bob gmail` with no command lists saved threads (offline, read-only). `-r` adds live message counts.

Examples:
  bob gmail                   List saved threads
  bob gmail -a                List every saved thread
  bob gmail -r                Fetch live new-message counts
  bob gmail -f json           List saved threads as JSON
  bob gmail new -t EMAIL      Create a local compose note
  bob gmail peek URL          Preview a Gmail link
  bob gmail reply NOTE        Add a Reply section
  bob gmail send NOTE         Preview and confirm a Gmail draft send
  bob gmail save URL          Save a Gmail thread
  bob gmail search            Search recent inbox threads
  bob gmail save ID -d        Preview a save without writing
  bob gmail link tasks.md     Swap Gmail URLs for labelled links
  bob gmail link -a -d        Preview a backfill of old URLs
  bob gmail sync              File labelled threads into area or project notes
  bob gmail sync -d           Preview the label sync
  bob gmail sync -l 0         Watch and adopt only; file no new threads
  bob gmail attach NOTE 1     Import the first listed attachment
  bob gmail draft NOTE        Create or update and preview a Gmail draft
  bob gmail login             Connect Gmail in one guided step
  bob gmail login -a EMAIL    Sign in as this account
  bob gmail login -s compose  Also grant the compose scope (Mac only)
  bob gmail login -s modify   Grant Gmail modify for label archiving
  bob gmail doctor            Diagnose gog, the client, and the vault
  bob gmail logout -y         Remove Bob's Gmail grant only

Environment:
  BOB_DIR            Bob vault root; defaults to ~/bob
  BOB_CONFIG_FILE    gmail config; defaults to ~/.config/bob/config.yml
  BOB_GMAIL_GOG      overrides gmail.gog and gog on PATH
  BOB_GMAIL_BROWSER  Browser executable; selects browser sign-in (otherwise automatic)
```
